projects.title: Apptics SaaS Explainer Ad
projects.subtitle: Editorial media
projects.description: A fast-paced SaaS explainer ad for Apptics, announcing their partnership with Whop to fix e-commerce payment processing. The video opens with the pain points merchants face, including payment holds, account bans, no control, and no support, then pivots to the solution: payouts in 1-2 business days and the lowest fees in the industry. Built to hook quickly, communicate value in seconds, and drive viewers to switch at apptics.ai.

projects.title: A Short and Brief History of the NSX
projects.subtitle: Editorial media
projects.description:
A quick look at the mighty history of the Honda NSX - from Honda's economy car days to the supercar that beat Ferrari at its own game for half the price.

I spent a lot of time meticulously making the animations and finding archive footage. The style is inspired by Vox videos, with an original mix of funky texture and playful movements.
